name: What maintenance is required for a custom wooden staircase?
description: Custom wooden staircases require regular cleaning and occasional refinishing every 5-10 years to maintain their appearance and structural integrity.

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for a custom wooden staircase?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintenance for a custom wooden staircase primarily involves regular cleaning and occasional refinishing to preserve its appearance and structural integrity. Regular dusting and cleaning with a wood-specific cleaner can prevent buildup. Depending on foot traffic and wear, a wooden staircase may need refinishing every 5-10 years to protect the wood and restore its luster. Hometelligent Inc. advises clients on appropriate care based on the specific wood type and finish used, providing guidance to ensure the longevity and beauty of their custom staircase.
